title: Church news: reading one post
question: A post now carries headings, lists, quotes, links, pictures with captions, galleries, video and audio, files to download, and a link button (here, See it in the calendar). The same page shows a ministry's post too, saying which ministry it's from. How should one post read on the phone? The admin panel shows the same post beside its editor.

options.label: Its pictures and videos lead, as a strip
options.thesis: Every picture and video in the post leads at the top as one swipeable strip (1 of 5); the words follow, and each still shows in place in the text.
options.viewport: Top bar with back to News, the strip at 1 of 5, dots, then the title, who posted it and when, and the start of the text.
options.risk: A post with one picture shows it twice (top and in the text) unless the strip only gathers posts with several.

options.label: The first picture as its cover
options.thesis: The post's first picture fills the top behind the bar, with the title and who posted it set over its dark lower edge; a post with no picture opens on the navy masthead instead.
options.viewport: The cover picture under a clear top bar, the title and Church office · Thursday 13 November over it, then the text.
options.risk: Light pictures need the gradient to keep the title readable, and a tall cover pushes the words below the fold.

options.label: An article, picture first
options.thesis: A plain article: the first picture inside the margins with rounded corners, then the title, who posted it and when, and the text with everything in place.
options.viewport: Navy top bar with back to News, the picture, the title, Church office · Thursday 13 November, then the text.
options.risk: Calm and familiar, but the least like the church's own bulletin of the three.
